address: 1 Lower Street, Islip, OX5 2SB, United Kingdom
bio: Owned by one of the villagers, this traditional-looking pub is not all that it seems; instead of walking through the door and finding yourself at the bar, you’ll now find yourself facing the open kitchen. Sit in the lounge for a cocktail before heading through to the Cygnet restaurant, where fairy lights hang from the beams and art is for sale on the walls. Modern British classics are the focus of the menu, with the desserts taking an appealing 'proper pudding' approach with the likes of a satisfying Bakewell tart. The bubbly team keep up the genial atmosphere....
